Fakel welcome Rodina Moskva to Voronezh on 24 October 2026 for a Russian Premier League fixture that kicks off at 12:00 GMT. Both clubs sit on six points after eleven rounds, occupying the bottom two places in the table and separated only by goal difference. This is a direct relegation six-pointer with each team desperate for a first win in several outings.

Fakel have collected one win, three draws and seven defeats, scoring eight goals and conceding nineteen. Rodina Moskva share the same win-draw-loss record but have shipped twenty-seven goals while scoring twelve. Rodina have won both previous meetings between the sides, including a 3-1 victory at this venue in April 2026. The visitors therefore hold a psychological edge, yet the stakes are identical: three points could lift the winner out of the automatic relegation places depending on other results.

Why This Match Matters

Rayo Vallecano occupy 14th place with nine points from eight matches (two wins, three draws, three losses). Elche are 18th with seven points from nine matches (one win, four draws, four losses). A win for Rayo would extend their gap over the relegation zone to five points, while a victory for Elche would lift them level on points with their hosts. Both teams have struggled for consistency early in the campaign, and three points here would provide a significant psychological boost ahead of a congested fixture period. The match also carries added weight given Elche's recent dominance in this head-to-head, including a 4-0 win at their own stadium in December 2025.
